description: Branch-specific project map for The Ledger (Gemini 1M context). Loaded automatically by syndicate-session.sh when on a mission/ branch. Provides The Ledger with a structured snapshot of the codebase state relevant to this mission.

structure.description: Directory layout relevant to this mission. The Ledger should populate this from codebase exploration at session start.

mission_scope.description: Files and modules this mission is authorized to modify. The Ledger uses this to focus context retrieval.

dependencies.description: All project dependencies with version and status. The Ledger updates this; The Gavel audits against it.

prior_decisions.description: Architectural decisions from AUDIT_LOG.md that are relevant to this mission. The Ledger surfaces these to prevent contradictory decisions.

open_questions.description: Unresolved items from prior sessions that may affect this mission.

context_anchors.description: Pre-loaded facts The Ledger should treat as ground truth at session start.

session_state.description: Populated by The Ledger during an active session. Do not pre-fill — updated at runtime.
